name: Cosmic Comics
tagline: Read Comics, Manga and Ebooks the easy way
blurb: Cosmic Comics offers a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to browse the collection of comics, manga and ebooks.
description:
Cosmic Comics offers a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to browse the collection of comics, manga and ebooks. It supports different file formats, offers adaptive page layout, favorite page marking, advanced search and library management.

What Cosmic Comics can do:

• Read a wide range of formats: CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR archives, PDF and EPUB documents, and folders of PNG, JPG, JPEG or BMP images

• Browse your collection by series and books, with covers fetched from APIs, extracted from files or set manually

• Track your reading progress: mark books as read, unread or reading, add them to favorites and rate them

• Powerful viewer options: zoom, auto background color, double page mode, blank first page, manga mode, webtoon mode, fullscreen, rotations, bookmarks, slideshow, sidebar and magnifier

• Rich metadata about your comics, manga and ebooks

• Downloaders for Marvel Unlimited, MangaDex, DC Infinite, Viz and GetComics (some require a subscription)

• Library metadata from Google Books, AniList, Metron, Open Library or manual entry

• Continue reading right where you left off

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
